messages:
Ivy (AE): Heads up 40min: MeridianX escalated to CTO. POC blocked: SSO failing (audience mismatch), p95 regression when clients mix 1- and 2k-token contexts, and procurement wants a 30-day pilot price. Need owners + quick plan.

Ravi (Presales): I'll draft pilot pricing + convertible commit option. Need their expected tokens/day.

Sam (SRE): Logs show kv cache churn on mixed-length sessions. Can run a 15m canary with kv-prefetch v2; expect drop in kv_miss.

Clara (Security): They want BYO-KMS options; legal will need DPA addendum. Also request SOC2 and TLS cipher list. I'll attach links.

Jules (Legal): Can fast-track a scoped DPA for pilot; flag whether HSM required.

BridgeBot: Bridge created: BR-8890. Tentative 2:30pm PT.

Ivy (AE): Owners: Ravi=pricing; Sam=canary/perf; Clara=security docs+KMS path; Jules=DPA. One-liner for invite?

Ravi (Presales): One-liner: "Run a short canary with kv-prefetch, complete SSO metadata exchange, and present a 30-day pilot pricing option to close the POC."

Sam (SRE): Canary started: p95 580ms -> 310ms after kv-prefetch; kv_miss 21% -> 5.2%. CSV: https://perf.redwood/r/prf-342.csv

Ivy (AE): Sending invite now. Will attach SOC2 + KMS attestation and pricing draft. Post-bridge notes in BR-8890."
